# GitHub Copilot instructions

All contributor, architecture, and testing guidance for this project lives in a
single source of truth: **[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)**.

Read it before making changes. In particular, see the **For AI agents** section,
whose Rule 0 requires that every completed task review and (if necessary) update
both `README.md` (user-facing docs) and `CONTRIBUTING.md` (developer/agent docs).
